'''Errops''' were a domesticated [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. They were used as draft beasts, and were notable for being furry and walking with a shuffling gait.<ref name="NoP" />
